panels.title: 🤖 AI Automation Risk Distribution
panels.description: Percentage of jobs at each AI replacement risk level

targets.rawSql: SELECT risk_category || ' (' || percentage || '%)' AS risk_level, job_count FROM vw_risk_distribution;

panels.title: 📊 Risk Breakdown by Job Source
panels.description: How many high/medium/low risk jobs from each data source

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, high_risk, medium_risk, low_risk FROM vw_risk_by_source;

panels.title: 🏢 Average Risk % by Company
panels.description: Companies ranked by average AI replacement risk of their job postings

targets.rawSql: SELECT company_name, avg_risk_pct FROM vw_risk_by_company ORDER BY avg_risk_pct DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: ⚠️ Known Occupation Automation Risk (Research Data)
panels.description: AI automation risk percentages from Frey & Osborne research — occupations most likely to be replaced by AI

targets.rawSql: SELECT occupation_name AS "Occupation", automation_risk_pct AS "AI Risk %", risk_category AS "Risk Level" FROM vw_occupation_risk;

panels.title: 🔴 High Risk Jobs (Most Likely Replaced by AI)
panels.description: Individual job postings classified as HIGH risk for AI automation

targets.rawSql: SELECT title AS "Job Title", company_name AS "Company", location AS "Location", risk_pct AS "AI Risk %", source AS "Source" FROM vw_high_risk_jobs LIMIT 50;

panels.title: 🟢 Safe Jobs (Growing Despite AI)
panels.description: Job titles with the LOWEST automation risk — roles that AI is LEAST likely to replace

targets.rawSql: SELECT title AS "Job Title", company_name AS "Company", location AS "Location", risk_pct AS "AI Risk %", source AS "Source" FROM vw_low_risk_jobs LIMIT 50;

panels.title: 📈 AI Risk % by Job Title (Aggregated)
panels.description: Average automation risk percentage grouped by job title

targets.rawSql: SELECT title, avg_risk_pct FROM vw_risk_by_title ORDER BY avg_risk_pct DESC LIMIT 25;
